title: Independent audit of R437 OQ4 transition and staged544 admission replay
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds only research/staged544-r437-admission-audit/: a scoped independent R437 OQ4 template-transition audit and explicitly partial staged544 execution evidence. Original fork review: https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6.

The new standard-library checker imports no predecessor verifier. It authenticates both literal templates, rederives idle windows by last-touch scans, checks 3933 stage/helper slots per replica, chronology and residual suffixes, and reconstructs both complete owner maps including 125856 helper occurrences per head. Exactly 69 semantic leaves change; 32 helper owner descriptors move and the profile delta is {26:32,34:-64,42:32}, preserving rank mass and child count. Every other field, including programs, schedule, cover and stock, is unchanged. Seven mutants are rejected. Modified-program/cover controls pass geometry and fail exhaustive transition, preventing inheritance of old identity coverage to changed programs. Strict concavity proves the improvement direction for 0<c<1 under the unchanged inherited invoice.

This does not discover the slot move, re-prove the full word identity, admit a supplier, establish a new physical hosting theorem or change the selected kappa/frontier.

## Task and overlap

Scope: exact-head supplier/admission audit, refined to the OQ4 transition and bounded staged544 evidence; see package TASK.json. Base: 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90; priority revision 6. Scientific head: b122e6ceab16bc1c6df818490ea5a21e864e0786. The upstream comparison has one commit and eleven files. Current AGENTS.md, autoresearch.md and CONTRIBUTING.md were read for submission.

PR3647: old head 36ff441479ff9c7e70d83f0becccd44da50effb8 (covered by PR3700) versus current head a24f9ff95c12fd0b6792e3f710569237efd72db2. PR3802/T385: de2cd5c58009205210e3bf328b0ef5cadf3903af. Both templates are retained with SHA256/Git-blob pins. Added value over PR3700 is exhaustive coverage of the actual changed head, plus explicit execution-stage boundaries. Relevant PR overlap was checked in the original investigation; Discussion coverage/posting was unavailable then. No exhaustive novelty claim or new reservation is made.

## Validation

    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged544-r437-admission-audit
    python3.12 -O -B research/staged544-r437-admission-audit/verify.py
    python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/staged544-r437-admission-audit --check-source-history

Recorded publication/bounded T385 run: https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39188328699. Metadata, registered replay, optimised receipt equality, history/publication bytes, Git-free replay and CLI altered-input/result, missing-input and symlink controls passed at the scientific head. Original execution: https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39186343975.

R437's existing cold verifier passed all 13 commands under hosted Python 3.12.15 and local 3.13.5; c=1736646042038446578551/10^24 and next-grid rejection were cross-checked with the unmodified PR3700 rational engine, and the old profile at new c was rejected. These reused-code runs are distinct from the new transition implementation.

The full T385 wrapper reached its 780-second limit in discovery/audit (exit 124). Owners, parent-lift, rebind, discovery bind and emit passed. Status remained PREPARED_REPLICA_SAME_WORD_DERIVATIVE_NOT_ADMITTED; no fresh full discovery, outer stages or release pass is claimed. A later bounded Python 3.12.15 verifier passed the exact aggregate, 1413720 literal roles, three owner controls, regenerated outer ledgers and conditional-gain checks. This authenticates stored evidence; it does not convert the timeout into a complete replay. These are prior recorded executions; no new scientific execution is claimed by this browser publication.

## Credit

Credit ai-nanachi/PR3647, Sagar Thakrar/PR3700 (old-head auditor, OQ4 placement and reused pricing), Ali Romman/PR1043, dataisfire/PR3734, hexapode/PR3802, ChaloupeMusic/PR3815 and the retained native/owner/outer lineage. New checker, controls, execution and writing by Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI assistance. No independent human or formal-kernel review. Apache-2.0 and source notices retained.

## Open next questions

See package README.md and TASK.json. Complete a longer fresh T385 replay through discovery, both outer stages and release, retaining exact source and explicit reuse coverage. All-size compiler, mutable-SOURCE, arbitrary capture-stream, whole-call hosting, precision/tape/recovery, analytic and BIT interfaces remain conditional. These are remaining obligations, not admission claims.
